content.json:
# Infrastructure Operational Workbook

Auto-generated from resource discovery. Source: `{{sourceSubscriptions}}` — inventory `{{inventoryTimestamp}}`.

Covers virtual machines, scale sets, and Arc-enabled servers.

---

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets','microsoft.hybridcompute/machines')
| extend powerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus)
| summarize Count = count() by type, location
| order by Count desc
content.title: Compute resources by type and region

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Origin == 'vm.azm.ms'
| where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage'
| summarize AvgCpu = avg(Val) by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Average CPU utilization (%)

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| extend Status = iff(LastHeartbeat < ago(5m), 'Stale', 'Healthy')
| project Computer, LastHeartbeat, Status
| order by Status asc, Computer asc
content.title: Agent heartbeat health
